svg.title: Packages go into the OpenFjord modeling language, and five kinds of users get what it knows
svg.desc: On the left, packages of definitions. In the middle, the OpenFjord modeling language and its tool, of-lang, which checks, derives, explains and tests. On the right, the users: an agent, an MCP server, a coding factory, a knowledge base and a semantic layer.
svg.text: the model as tools to call
rules that reject a wrong change
